answer: The delay is fixed in the contract, and the cancellation window is open to the owner alone. A farm needs 566 separate recovery requests, since one delay cannot cover 566 accounts. Recovery takes effect only after a delay, and the owner can cancel it inside the window. Watch the hollow: the farm pays per alias, the honest agent pays once, the cipher bond is locked until the epoch ends, and the thread audit is open to anyone who wants to re-run it.
